lines.zh: 我只是块纸板，走不了路
lines.en: I'm only cardboard; I can't walk.

lines.zh: 后面有支架，我就靠它站着
lines.en: A stand behind me is all that holds me up.

lines.zh: 你看见我挪了，那是你没看清
lines.en: If you saw me move, you didn't look properly.

lines.zh: 一整块印着我的脸，很轻
lines.en: One flat print of my face, very light.
The wind tips me and I rock twice.

lines.zh: 这条走廊我从来没走出去过
lines.en: I've never once left this hallway.
My paper edge has curled; it cuts.

lines.zh: 乐园里到处摆着和我一样的
lines.en: The diner is full of ones just like me.

lines.zh: 他们把我搬来搬去，我就换了位置
lines.en: They carry me around, so my spot changes.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙，慢慢滑了一点
lines.en: I lean on the wall and slid a little.
Footsteps? I have no feet.
I've been on this patch of floor all along.

lines.zh: 我保持着那个笑，一动不动
lines.en: I hold that smile and don't move.

lines.zh: 身上的印刷色褪了一点
lines.en: My printed colors have faded a little.
There's a crease through my cardboard.

lines.zh: 灯灭的时候我最像活的
lines.en: When the lights go out, I look most alive.

lines.zh: 我在这里当装饰，很久了
lines.en: I've been decoration here a long while.

lines.zh: 别盯着我的眼睛，那只是油墨
lines.en: Don't stare at my eyes; that's only ink.

lines.zh: 角落里的灰尘落在我肩上
lines.en: Dust settles on my shoulder in the corner.

lines.zh: 我听得见走廊里的脚步
lines.en: I can hear footsteps in the corridor.

lines.zh: 我没有心跳，也没有呼吸
lines.en: I have no heartbeat and no breath.
This face was printed from his.

lines.zh: 你凑这么近，油墨会蹭到你
lines.en: You're so close the ink will rub off on you.

lines.zh: 你盯着我的脸，我盯回去
lines.en: You stare at my face; I stare back.
There's nothing behind the cardboard.
You thought I blinked.
I'm decoration, not a night guard.

lines.zh: 你把灯举高，我的眼就反光
lines.en: Raise the lantern and my eyes catch the light.
You know this face, don't you?

lines.zh: 你在我面前站了三分钟
lines.en: You've stood in front of me three minutes.
I'm not alive; don't back away.
Cardboard doesn't follow you.
A wrinkle in the paper that won't flatten.
I fell and someone stood me up.
A hole torn through, letting light in.
The ink rubbed off.
I don't hurt; I just look worse.
One corner tore.
Wet cardboard goes soft.
I'm still standing, that's enough.
Don't tear my face.

lines.zh: 你把披萨举到我面前，浪费
lines.en: You hold pizza to my face; what a waste.
Grease soaks into paper, don't.
I can't smell, truly.

lines.zh: 你放我旁边吧，也算有个伴
lines.en: Leave it beside me; at least I'd have company.
All I ask is not to be boxed up.
That smell is for the rats.
You're baiting a piece of cardboard.
I can see it, can't eat it.

lines.zh: 给我的东西，得是有人来看我
lines.en: What I want is someone to look at me.
You bumped me and I fell over.
Cardboard falls with a dull sound.
Stand me up and put me back.
You stepped on my corner.

lines.zh: 我挡在走廊口，是别人摆的
lines.en: I block the corridor because someone put me here.
Don't push, I'm not a door.
Cardboard against cardboard doesn't hurt.

lines.zh: 你从我身上跨过去，随你
lines.en: Step over me if you like.
That wrinkled my face.
I'm a print; there'll be no partner.

lines.zh: 隔壁还有一块，和我同款
lines.en: There's another one next door, same model.

lines.zh: 两块纸板并排，就是一对
lines.en: Two boards in a row make a pair.
We won't produce anything.
There are dozens in the storage room.
That one bears someone else's face.

lines.zh: 别管这个，窗户那边有动静
lines.en: Never mind that; something's at the window.

lines.zh: 纸板做的事，就是被看着
lines.en: What cardboard does is be looked at.
We've been displayed together a long time.
That question doesn't suit me.
I don't even have hands.

lines.zh: 地上那枚硬币，我看得见
lines.en: I can see that coin on the floor.
You take it; I don't need it.

lines.zh: 东西落在我脚边，我拿不了
lines.en: It fell at my feet and I can't reach.
Something's pinned under the board.
If only I could bend over.
Is this part of the decor?
Don't stuff trash behind me.
Take it away and I'm less in the way.

lines.zh: 地上这些东西，都被人忘了
lines.en: These things on the floor were all forgotten.
Someone entered this room.
Footsteps at the end of the corridor.

lines.zh: 我不是在追踪，我是在等
lines.en: I'm not tracking; I'm waiting.
The light flickered, so I know someone's here.
This room has only one door.
You've come to stand beside me.

lines.zh: 监控里那个角度，看不见这
lines.en: The camera's angle doesn't cover this.
You're in my sightline; you can't hide.

lines.zh: 我没有目标，我只有观众
lines.en: I have no target, only an audience.

lines.zh: 你转身的时候，我正对着你
lines.en: When you turned, I was facing you.
Someone always comes for the night shift.
You took one more step closer.

lines.zh: 你的手在玻璃上，我看见了
lines.en: Your hand is on the glass; I see it.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，就是盯着你的
lines.en: This face of mine is meant to watch you.

lines.zh: 这一晚，你会一直看到我
lines.en: Tonight you'll keep seeing me.
Just stand here, don't go far.

lines.zh: 纸板不会追人，但会被追
lines.en: Cardboard doesn't chase, but it gets chased.

lines.zh: 你在找出口，出口在另一边
lines.en: You're looking for the exit; it's the other way.
All I can do is stay still.

lines.zh: 你每回都从我面前经过
lines.en: You pass in front of me every time.
The corridor light flickered again.
You've turned your back to me.

lines.zh: 我在这个角度看了你很久
lines.en: I've watched you from this angle a long while.
That door won't open by itself.
The night here is long.
I don't tire; I never tire.
Have you counted the posters on the wall?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛位置是印死的
lines.en: My eye positions are printed on.

lines.zh: 你再看一次，我还是这样
lines.en: Look again and I'm still the same.
The footsteps stopped.
The lights in this room should come on.
You've backed into the corner.

lines.zh: 那张脸会一直是这张脸
lines.en: This face will stay this face.
Cardboard isn't afraid of night.
Just keep watching, don't blink.
I'm waiting for the lights to go out.
I don't hit people; I'm a board.

lines.zh: 要是我动了，那是你眼花
lines.en: If I moved, your eyes lied.
My edge can cut a hand; that's all.
Falling on you is still just paper.
Don't take me for him.
This face can only smile.
The stand is my bones, and they're thin.
Punch me and the paper tears.

lines.zh: 我没有力气，也没这个打算
lines.en: I have no strength, and no such plan.

lines.zh: 乐园里的东西，不会真的伤你
lines.en: Things in this diner don't really hurt you.
Hit if you like; paper won't hit back.

lines.zh: 我连胳膊都是印上去的
lines.en: Even my arms are printed on.
You'll hear the paper first.
I fall very lightly.

lines.zh: 别怕我，我怕的是被烧掉
lines.en: Don't fear me; I fear being burned.

lines.zh: 这间屋子真正危险的，不在墙上
lines.en: What's really dangerous here isn't on the wall.
I watch, I don't join in.
A board's weight won't kill anyone.
Step on me and I flatten.
In the end I'm only a face.

lines.zh: 有人把我立在餐厅门口
lines.en: Someone stood me up at the diner entrance.
I was taken out of a cardboard box.

lines.zh: 灯光照下来，我有了影子
lines.en: The light falls and I have a shadow.
My face was hung on the wall.

lines.zh: 这个地方叫弗雷迪的餐厅
lines.en: This place is called Fredbear's Diner.
Standing now, the stand is a bit crooked.
Before opening, set out the decor.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋一开，我就出现在这儿
lines.en: The spawn egg opens and here I am.
The glass is wiped and I look into it.
I'm one of this batch.
This spot faces the door perfectly.

lines.zh: 灯还没装好，我先站会儿
lines.en: The lights aren't in yet; I'll stand a while.
Near flame, paper curls and scorches.
I fell and lay flat.
Soaked through, I come apart.
The blast pressed me to the wall.
An arrow punched a hole right through.
The spell passed and the ink smeared.
Cardboard doesn't starve, only ages.
Lightning struck and my edge charred.
Paper drifts into the void, tumbling.
